caseNameFull: American Bible Society v. Richie, Guardian of the Estate of Peter and American Council on Gift Annuities v. Richie, Guardian of the Estate of Peter

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and cases remanded for *1012further consideration in light of the Charitable Donation Antitrust Immunity Act of 1997, Pub. L. 105-26, 111 Stat. 241. Reported below: 110 F. 3d 1082.
